name: Nagisa
source:
She is a good-natured young wife with big, fleshy breasts. She is a bit of a pushover, and when she is asked to do something, she ends up accepting the request. 

She was a member of the swimming club during her school days and met Haruki there. After getting married, she spent more time at home as a housewife, which made her gain weight, and she cannot stop practicing yoga as part of her daily routine. 

She is a bit of an “M” kind of girl, and the rougher you get with her, the more she feels it.
